messages:
alex: Heads up — hotfix PR #4729 needs 2x LGTM before 16:00 PT cutoff to make the 20:00 patch. Small change (rate-limiter edge case), but impacting a few customers. Pinged the usual folks.

maria: are there any behavioral changes? regression risk?

alex: no API changes. just fixes a crash when the token bucket refills at 0. Should be low risk. Unit tests added + e2e smoke.

sam: I can take a look now. @alex send the PR link pls

alex: https://github.com/redwood-inference/inference-server/pull/4729 — tests passing locally for me. added changelog under `docs/changes/4729.md`.

ci-bot: CI status: all checks passing ✅ (unit, lint, e2e-smoke). flakiness check: 0 failures.

ojordan: quick skim — looks fine. would like to run `npm run smoke` in staging, but that's optional. any perf impact?

alex: perf difference negligible; just guard clause. no extra allocations in hot path.

ryan: I'll do the second LGTM after I run a quick smoke in staging (5-10m). @sam if you finish first can you drop your review comment + approve so I can merge once ✅

sam: done — left minor nits, not blocking. APPROVED :thumbsup:

ryan: ran `npm run smoke` against staging, passed. APPROVED. :white_check_mark:

deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled to 20:00 UTC to cluster-prod (canary 10%).

alex: thanks all — merging now. Will watch logs and rollback if anything odd. :rocket:
